body:
Cache checkpoints previously saved and restored every field of a model cache, including its `AbstractSpace`s and their `local_geometry_field`s. CliMA/ClimaCore.jl#2717 stored local geometry fields in arrays that could not be modified, so restoring the cache would throw an error (see the restart jobs of downstream build [98](https://buildkite.com/clima/climacoupler-downstream/builds/98)). That PR has since been closed, but it will be revived after ClimaCore's dependencies are [updated to properly support `CUDA.Const`](https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCore.jl/pull/2717#pullrequestreview-5772678734).

`CacheIterator` now stops at ClimaCore spaces and grids, and `restore!` ignores them, since they remain unchanged during simulations. These changes will ensure that CliMA/ClimaCore.jl#2717 passes its downstream tests pass once it gets revived.

This PR was generated using Claude Code.
title: Do not save or restore ClimaCore spaces in checkpoints

Adds an example to the docs that runs one year of the coarse fully coupled configuration,
`config/longrun_configs/cmip_coarse.yml`, on one GPU and plots the monthly-mean wind over the polar
oceans, their sea ice, and the surrounding land.
